entities.summary: Franz Xaver Kroetz is a German author, playwright, actor and film director. He achieved great success beginning in the early 1970s. Persistent, Farmyard, and Request Concert, all written in 1971, are some of the works conventionally associated with Kroetz. Franz Xaver Kroetz was a poets & playwrights from Munich (b. 1946-02-25, Munich). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
